item.title: Magic’s KPop Demon Hunters Secret Lair Is Coming Sooner Than You Think
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: Magic: The Gathering's latest Secret Lair crossover features KPop Demon Hunters, Marvel, and Labryrinth.
item.content:encoded: Not long after Hasbro inked a partnership with Netflix last year to license KPop Demon Hunterstoys and other merchandise, the company’s CEO Chris Cocks confirmed that a Magic: The Gathering Secret Lair product was in development as well. Now, nearly a year later, we finally have an inkling as to exactly when it’ll be released.

item.title: God of War Laufey Is Quietly a Preview of PlayStation's Future
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: God of War Laufey will be released on PS5\ on Feb. 27, but the deluxe edition goodies won't be available for those who purchase a physical copy
item.content:encoded: God of War Laufey will be released on PlayStation 5 next February, in what's already shaping up to be a packed month for video game releases. Just this week, we got our first look at the preorder and deluxe edition bonuses for Santa Monica Studio's next game. On its face, it's the usual assortment of bonus in-game items. But the standard edition of God of War Laufeyhas one big advantage over the deluxe version — you can buy a physical copy of the game. The deluxe version is strictly digital-only.

item.title: 'Game of Thrones' Officially Returns in 2029 with First Movie
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: Game of Thrones: Aegon's Conquest gets a June 2029 release date from Warner Bros and HBO, the first feature film in George R.R. Martin's fantasy epic.
item.content:encoded: HBO's Game of Thrones is officially coming to movie theaters. Warner Bros. announced Tuesday that the first feature film in the George R.R. Martin-created franchise, Game of Thrones: Aegon's Conquest, will hit cinemas in spring 2029.

item.title: An NFL Legend Is About to Reveal the Minecraft City He Spent 12 Years Building
item.dc:creator: Lillian Ali
item.description: The former head coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers is showing off his 12-year creative mode project this Wednesday.
item.content:encoded: Former Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike Tomlin has set plenty of records throughout his career. After winning the 2008 AFC Championship Game, he became the youngest NFL head coach to reach a Super Bowl. A few weeks later, he became the youngest coach to win a Super Bowl (Los Angeles Rams coach Sean McVay has since surpassed both records). In his 19 years with the Steelers, Tomlin never had a losing season — the longest such streak in the league’s history.

item.title: Xbox’s Platinum Trophy Equivalent Officially Revealed
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: Mythic Achievements, Xbox's long-overdue answer to PlayStation's Platinum Trophy, are real and available starting today
item.content:encoded: After leaking earlier this week, Xbox has officially revealed Mythic Achievements, the company's answer to PlayStations Platinum Trophy. Players don't have to wait long to get access to the feature. It will be available starting today for those enrolled in the Xbox Insider program.

item.title: 'GTA 6' Fans Are Hammering the Game Informer App Into Oblivion Right Now
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: The gaming magazine's app can't seem to handle all the interest in its exclusive GTA 6 news and screenshots as users report issues and glitches
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 fans have been anticipating the September issue of Game Informer since the magazine revealed an exclusive spread on Rockstar's open-world game, but the hype appears to be more than the outlet can handle. Readers are reporting a number of issues accessing the new GTA 6 material hours after the magazine officially released it.

item.title: All paralogue dates and deadlines in Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.description: These are all the paralogues in Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave, including paralogue start dates and end dates
item.content:encoded: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave's paralogues operate on strict deadlines, and they can be very easy to miss. However, they're among the most important optional quests you can take on. Paralogues are how you get certain plot-important characters to join your team later, and if you don't have time or don't want to play multiple routes, you can also use paralogues to get the three other Flame Lords to join you in Part 3, albeit in a limited capacity.

item.title: Lego Officially Retiring Star Wars and X-Men Sets in 2026
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: Later this year, Lego is discontinuing some of its best sets, including the Millennium Falcon.
item.content:encoded: Most Lego sets are here for a good time, not a long time. The Lego Company regularly cycles older builds out of active production to make room for new ones. After stock runs out in stores, they become exclusively available through secondary markets like eBay, where they fetch much higher prices than their original market value. Earlier this month, Brick Fanatics compiled a list of every Lego set being discontinued at the end of 2026, and there are some real heavyweights in the bunch. Star Wars, Marvel, DC, Jurassic World, Mario, Animal Crossing, and One Piece all have builds headed for the big brick factory in the sky. Here are five of the most notable sets being retired.

item.title: Brendan Fraser's 124-Minute Action Thriller Classic Is Back From the Dead on Streaming
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.category: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
item.description: Brendan Fraser’s The Mummy is climbing Netflix’s charts following the release of new set photos from The Mummy 4.
item.content:encoded: Brendan Fraser has had one hell of a career. He went from playing a lovable goofball in Encino Man to battling dinosaurs in Journey to the Center of the Earth, winning an Oscar for The Whale, and, of course, becoming an unlikely action hero in one of the biggest adventure franchises of the late ’90s and early 2000s.

item.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Is Officially the Best-Reviewed Game of the Year
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: CD Project Red's update to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt has a 94 rating on Metacritic. Can GTA 6 beat it?
item.content:encoded: It's 2026. Is an 11-year-old epic RPG really the best new release you can buy? Yes — according to Metacritic, anyway. At the review aggregation site, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered sits atop the ranking of all new releases for 2026, with a sky-high 94 Metascore.
